author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Restore the Android audio route after disconnecting a headset
summary: Record the active route, disconnect once, compare system media and PS2 audio, then rebuild only the emulator audio session or Android route needed for reliable recovery.
heroAlt: Battlefield 2 scene retained at a known audible moment while a headset disconnect and Android route transition are tested

blocks.text: Record the route transition before forcing a reset
Recover sound when Android keeps, delays, or changes the output route after wired, USB, or Bluetooth headphones disconnect.
Repeatedly toggling Bluetooth and restarting the phone can erase the sequence that exposes a reproducible route-transition defect.
Prepare system and emulator audio controls

items: Output selector and media-volume state visible.
Known non-emulator media clip ready as a route control.
Game paused at a scene with continuous audible output.

blocks.text: Find the first layer that fails to follow the disconnect

items: 1. Confirm PS2 audio and control media use the intended headset.
2. Disconnect the device once using its normal procedure.
3. Observe Android's selected output before changing any toggle.
4. Play control media and compare it with the paused game session.
5. If only the emulator is silent, background and resume once to recreate focus.
6. If all media is misrouted, choose the intended available system output explicitly.
7. Cold-relaunch the emulator without repairing unrelated settings.
8. Reconnect and disconnect again to verify the route transition is repeatable.

blocks.text: If all apps remain silent, the route or system owns the fault; if only the emulator session is silent, recreating that audio session is the narrower test.
Audio moves to the intended available output without duplicate playback, prolonged silence, or a manual fix on every session.

items: Android identifies the expected active output after disconnect.
System media and PS2 audio agree on the selected route.
A second disconnect recovers without rebooting the phone.
Bluetooth shows connected after power-off: remove only the stale connection and retry.
USB audio disappears with the hub: inspect host power and adapter stability.
Control media works but game stays silent: rebuild the app audio session.
Volume is zero on the new route: restore its independent media level.

blocks.text: Reconnect the original headset and restore its recorded media volume and codec state.
Android can retain separate volume per route
A successful transition may sound silent because the phone speaker, USB device, and Bluetooth headset remember different media levels.
